test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct direct speech:
 She said that she used to play the violin when she was young

options.text: “I played the violin when I was young,” she said
“I use to play the violin when I was young,” she said
“I used to play the violin when I was young,” she said
“I was playing the violin when I was young,” she said

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she used to play the violin when she was young.
 
• **Key Conversion:** The phrase "used to" is retained as it represents a past habit.
 
 
• **"She used to play" becomes "I used to play"**
 
 
• Pronoun "she" is changed to "I" to match direct speech.
 
• The verb "used to" remains unchanged as it accurately conveys the past habitual action.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "she said"
 
• Converted to: "she said" in direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "I" and ends with a comma before the reporting clause.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“I used to play the violin when I was young,” she said."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "I played the violin when I was young," she said.
 
 
• The verb "played" changes the meaning to a single event rather than a habitual action.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "I use to play the violin when I was young," she said.
 
 
• The phrase "use to" is incorrect due to improper grammar.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "I was playing the violin when I was young," she said.
 
 
• The verb "was playing" changes the meaning to an ongoing action rather than a habitual action.
